Shared defect, not a differentiator: pressing escape calls the coroutine self.app.set_focus(None) without await (patch.diff:571; base src/textual/app.py:306 is async), so focus is not removed. The reference has the same call (reference tabs.py:247-248). The generated docstring states this honestly (patch.diff:553-554).
criteria.deficiency: Shared with the reference: the Escape branch does not remove focus. Behaviour differs only in the edge cases noted (empty tabs with a given active_tab keeps None, not the given name; non-single-character keys skip first-character search). Neither is a stated requirement.
